primary_public_comparison.criterion: minimum FAR subject to the same Recall >= 99% requirement

exact_recall_frontier_note: All shared exact-TP operating points with recall >=99% are exported for both model families. The effect is model- and operating-point-dependent; the file is included for transparency rather than to claim universal FAR reduction.
target_note: The released sample-level data represent the binary evaluation target generically as target_label.
